name: Missing Strict-Transport-Security
description: The website does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS header.

name: Missing Content-Security-Policy
description: No CSP defined leaving the application vulnerable to cross-site scripting and unauthorized resource loading.

name: Missing X-Frame-Options
description: The page lacks clickjacking defense headers allowing framing by external origins.

name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
description: MIME-type sniffing is not explicitly disabled by nosniff header.

name: Missing Referrer-Policy
description: Referrer headers may leak internal path parameters to external domains.

name: Cookie Missing Secure Flag
description: Session or state cookies transmitted over unencrypted channels if visited over HTTP.

name: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag
description: Client-side JavaScript can read sensitive cookie values.

name: Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute
description: Lack of SameSite attribute facilitates Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

name: Wildcard Origin with Credentials
description: Overly permissive CORS configuration allows third parties unauthorized data extraction.

name: Permissive Wildcard Access-Control
description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is set to wildcard asterisk on private resource.

name: Server Banner Version Leakage
description: Server header exposes detailed web server and operating system version string.

name: Technology Framework Banner Disclosed
description: X-Powered-By or framework header discloses backend programming stack.

name: Sensitive Metadata or Dotfile Exposed
description: Passive inspection indicates public availability of sensitive paths like robots.txt disallow trails or dotfiles.

name: Insecure TLS Version Supported
description: Web server negotiates legacy protocols such as TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1.

name: Certificate Near Expiration or Untrusted
description: X.509 certificate validation warning or imminent validity expiration.

name: Insecure HTTP Methods Permitted
description: Dangerous HTTP methods such as TRACE
column9: or arbitrary PUT are allowed on endpoint.

name: Insecure Plaintext HTTP Redirection Absent
description: Plaintext HTTP request does not automatically redirect to secure HTTPS endpoint.

name: Verbose Stack Trace or Debug Mode Active
description: Application returns detailed exception traces or database diagnostic messages.
